description: Workspace file paths are normalized and analyzed for filename, extension, hidden-path status, and Unicode diagnostic metadata.

cases.description: A normal ASCII file path reports its basename, extension, visibility, and byte counts.
cases.expected_output:
path=notes/daily/2024-01-01.md
name=2024-01-01.md
extension=md
hidden=false
is_nfc=true
is_nfd=true
has_non_ascii=false
char_length=25
byte_length=25

cases.description: A dotfile reports no extension and is considered hidden.
cases.expected_output:
path=.gitignore
name=.gitignore
extension=null
hidden=true
is_nfc=true
is_nfd=true
has_non_ascii=false
char_length=10
byte_length=10

cases.description: A file inside a hidden directory is considered hidden while still reporting its file extension.
cases.expected_output:
path=.obsidian/app.json
name=app.json
extension=json
hidden=true
is_nfc=true
is_nfd=true
has_non_ascii=false
char_length=18
byte_length=18

cases.description: A decomposed Unicode path is normalized before metadata is produced.
cases.expected_output:
path=dünya.md
name=dünya.md
extension=md
hidden=false
is_nfc=true
is_nfd=false
has_non_ascii=true
char_length=8
byte_length=9
